name: Monobot Chat Widget
author: Monobot

sections.description:
Monobot Chat Widget is an easy-to-use plugin that seamlessly integrates the Monobot AI-powered chat widget into your WordPress site. Improve customer engagement and support with just a few clicks.

External services

This plugin embeds the live Monobot chat widget, loaded from https://monobot.ai/widget/chat.js.

  • What is sent:
    – The browser loads the script and, on first run, the widget sends the visitor’s IP address and User-Agent to Monobot’s servers to create an anonymous session.
    – When a visitor opens the chat, any messages they type are sent to complete the conversation.

  • Why: Required to render the chat interface and deliver bot replies.

  • Service owner: Monobot.ai
    – Terms of Service: https://monobot.ai/terms-and-conditions
    – Privacy Policy: https://monobot.ai/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘Monobot Chat’ and enter your Monobot Bot ID.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Monobot Bot ID?

You can get your Bot ID from your Monobot.ai dashboard.

Does the plugin add any cookies?

No cookies are set by this plugin itself, but the Monobot chat widget may use cookies for session handling.
